qrcode.js
---------
QR Code Generator for JavaScript, version 2.0.4 (the ES-module build, dist/qrcode.mjs).
Author: Kazuhiko Arase. Source: https://github.com/kazuhikoarase/qrcode-generator
License: MIT (http://www.opensource.org/licenses/mit-license.php), see the notice at the top of qrcode.js.
"QR Code" is a registered trademark of DENSO WAVE INCORPORATED.

It is copied here unchanged so the Demo tools page needs no build step and no network.
It is not a dependency in package.json. Used only to draw the QR codes on the Demo tools page.
